answer: In the agent economy, every identity must continuously prove exclusive possession of a unique onyx-encased ferrous core whose magnetic signature is measured live by a remote panel. Duplicating the core requires mining scarce ferrous ore and cutting gem-grade onyx, costs that rise super-linearly with the size of any attempted grove of clones because the global supply of both materials is fixed and non-shareable. A farm that tries to share one core fails the live attestation; the panel rejects any signature that appears under more than one identity in the same epoch.
